blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en:
Enlarged perivascular spaces (PVS) visible in brain magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) are increasingly thought to be linked to poor brain health. PVS are elongated structures of less than 3 mm in diameter and can be numerous. To reflect the incidence of PVS, radiologists visually score their burden following a clinical grading scale—a task that would benefit from automation to accelerate analyses and overcome the influence of inter-observer differences.
We developed and evaluated methods for training machine learning models to score PVS incidence in the basal ganglia (BG) and centrum semiovale (CSO) leveraging the Potters/Wardlaw scale. The novelty in our work lies in the use of imperfect, semi-automatically generated “silver-standard” PVS segmentation masks during training, in addition to PVS radiological scores. We comparatively evaluated a conditional convolutional neural network (CNN) which accepts PVS masks as an extra input channel, a multi-task CNN which performs both PVS segmentation and scoring, and a logistic regression model which utilises features derived from PVS masks to predict PVS scores.
Multi-task learning was the most effective method, achieving a mean average precision of 64.08% compared to 60.22% for the conditional CNN, 52.11% for a baseline CNN trained only to predict PVS scores, and 49.32% for the logistic regression model. The multi-task model showed an ability to localise individual PVS not shown by the other CNNs, and behaved in a probabilistically sensible way, predicting with lower confidence on inherently harder classes. Age, sex, hypertension status, white matter hyperintensity volume, and ischaemic stroke lesion status were shown to be associated with the multi-task model’s PVS score predictions and the ground truth in a similar way.
blocks.zh:
在脑磁共振成像(MRI)中可见的扩大的心血管空间(PVS)越来越被认为与脑健康不良有关. PVS是直径小于3毫米的延长结构,可以数量众多. 为了反映PVS的发生率,放射科医生根据临床分级标准对其负担进行视评,这项工作将受益于自动化,以加快分析和克服观察者之间差异的影响。
我们制定并评估了培训机器学习模型的方法,以利用波特斯/沃德瓦夫的尺度,在玄武纪(BG)和半诺瓦莱(Centrum superovale)中得分PVS的发生率。 我们工作中的新颖之处在于,除了PVS放射性分数之外,在训练期间还使用了不完善、半自动生成的“银标准”PVS分区口罩。 我们比较评价了一个有条件的神经元网络(CNN),它接受PVS口罩作为额外的输入通道,一个多任务CNN同时进行PVS分级和评分,以及一个利用PVS口罩的特性预测PVS分数的物流回归模型.
多任务学习是最有效的方法,平均精度达到64.08%,有条件的CNN为60.22%,基线CNN仅为预测PVS分数训练的52.11%,物流回归模型49.32%。 多任务模式显示出能够将其他有线电视新闻网没有显示的个人PVS本地化,并以一种可能合理的方式行事,对固有的更困难的类具有较低的信心。 年龄,性别,高血压状态,白物质超强度体积,以及中风损伤状况被证明与多任务模型的PVS分数预测和地面真相有类似联系.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Perivascular spaces (PVS) are fluid-filled cavities surrounding small blood vessels in the brain, which, when they become enlarged, appear visible on magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) scans. They are known to be related to age, vascular risk factors, blood-brain-barrier leakage, cognitive decline, and small vessel disease (SVD) [ 25 ] .
blocks.zh: 旁血管空间(PVS)是围绕大脑中小血管的充满流体的腔体,这些血管体拓宽后,在磁共振成像(MRI)扫描中显现可见. 已知它们与年龄,血管风险因素,血脑障碍渗漏,认知下降以及小血管疾病有关[25].

blocks.zh: 图1:显示PVS . T1-加权(T1w),T2-加权(T2w),以及流体增压反演回收(FLAIR)(左-右)磁共振成像(MRI)扫描的示例. 可见的近血管空间(PVS)以红框显示,在T2w扫描中最显著的为白色光谱.

blocks.en: To quantify PVS burden, a number of visual grading scales have been developed. One such scale is the Potters/Wardlaw scale [ 17 ] , which relies on counting visible PVS within the basal ganglia (BG), centrum semiovale (CSO), and midbrain, resulting in one score per region of interest (ROI). The PVS count for one of these regions is defined as the maximum single-hemisphere count over all axial MRI slices where the region is present. For the BG and CSO, the score is then defined as: 0 (0 PVS), 1 (1-10 PVS), 2 (11-20 PVS), 3 (21-40 PVS), or 4 ( ≥ \geq 41 PVS). The midbrain follows a binary scale: 0 (0 PVS), and 1 ( ≥ \geq 1 PVS). However, in practice, the perceived burden of PVS-like or PVS-associated abnormalities will prevail in assigning the score [ 8 ] .
blocks.zh: 为了量化PVS负担,已经制定了一些视觉分级表. 其中的尺度是波特斯/沃德劳的尺度[17],它依靠在玄武岩块(BG),半脑(Centrum semiovale)和中脑内计算可见的PVS,结果每个感兴趣的区域得1分(ROI). 其中一个区域的PVS计数被定义为该区域存在的所有轴心核磁共振片的最大单层计数。 BG和CSO的得分随后被定义为:0(0 PVS),1(1-10 PVS),2(11-20 PVS),3(21-40 PVS),或4(\\ e) PVS41. 中脑采用二进制比例法:0(0 PVS),1(≥\geq 1 PVS). 然而,在实践中,在分配分数时,人们所意识到的类似PVS或PVS相关异常的负担将占上风。

blocks.en:
While most previous work in automated PVS analysis has focused on segmentation [ 28 ] , there does exist a body of research on automated PVS scoring.
Regardless of the flooring and ceiling effects that any scoring system may have, disease scoring is currently the most practical way to characterise disease stages in a harmonised way.
It is also robust against image acquisition differences, especially in the presence of highly anisotropic voxels, prevalent in clinical settings, which are unsuitable for deriving accurate PVS metrics from segmentation methods.
However, previous automated approaches have generally focused on dichotomised scales or isolated regions.
For example, [ 8 ] developed a support vector machine classifier based on bag of visual words (BoW) features from 2D slices of T2w MRI (masked to the BG), but their model only predicted a dichotomised version of the Potters/Wardlaw PVS score, and only in the BG.
Similarly, while [ 29 ] used a 3D CNN, they also relied on a dichotomised scale for the BG: 0 ( < < 10 PVS) or 1 ( ≥ \geq 10 PVS).
Other methods have shifted away from binned ordinal classes entirely; [ 7 ] trained four independent 3D CNNs to predict continuous PVS counts from T2w MRI (masked to the region of interest) for the BG, CSO, midbrain, and hippocampi, using the scale proposed by [ 1 ] .
Even when the standard non-dichotomised Potters/Wardlaw scale has been applied, such as the 2D CNN trained by [ 30 ] on enhanced and cropped T2w MRIs, predictions have been limited solely to the BG.
Consequently, a number of gaps remain in the literature. Firstly, no one has yet attempted to automate PVS scoring in both the BG and CSO using a non-dichotomised Potters/Wardlaw scale. Secondly, while the use of PVS score ground truth has previously been used in the development of PVS segmentation methods [ 2 ] , PVS segmentations are yet to be utilised in the development of automated PVS scoring models.
blocks.zh:
虽然以往在自动PVS分析中的大部分工作都侧重于分化[28],但确实存在一套关于自动PVS评分的研究.
无论任何评分系统可能具有何种底线和上限影响,疾病评分目前都是以协调方式确定疾病阶段特征的最实际方法。
与图像获取差异相比,这种差异也很强,特别是在临床环境中普遍存在的高度异同位素时,这些异异异同位素不适合通过分化方法得出准确的PVS度量。
然而,以往的自动化方法一般侧重于二分法尺度或孤立区域。
例如,[8]从T2w MRI的2D切片(被放大到BG)中开发了基于包视觉单词(BoW)特性的辅助矢量机分类器,但他们的模型只预言了波特斯/沃德瓦夫PVS分数的dichotomized版本,只在BG中.
同样,[29]虽然使用了3D CNN,但他们也依赖于BG:0( < 10 PVS)或1(\\ eq 10 PVS)的二合标。
其他方法已经完全脱离了binned ordinal课程; [7] 训练了四个独立的3D CNN来预测从T2w磁共振的连续PVS计数(被放大到感兴趣的区域),为BG,CSO,中脑,和河马pocampi,使用[1]提出的比例表.
即使应用了标准的非二氢化波特/沃德瓦夫尺度,例如[30]训练的2D CNN关于增强和裁剪的T2w MRI,预测也仅限于BG.
因此,文献中仍存在一些空白。 首先,还没有人试图使用非二分法的Potters/Wardlaw比例表使BG和CSO的PVS评分自动化。 第二,虽然使用PVS分数地面真伪以前曾用于开发PVS分数方法[2],但PVS分数尚未用于开发自动PVS分数模型.

blocks.en: In this work, we develop machine learning models for predicting the BG and CSO PVS scores on a modified (but not dichotomised) Potters/Wardlaw scale. Differently from previous work, we present methods that are designed to utilise PVS segmentation masks ( in addition to the ground truth PVS scores) during training and/or inference. The masks that we use in training are derived via a semi-automated pipeline and are therefore referred to as “silver-standard”. The ability to use these masks provides two main benefits. Firstly, the masks provide a lower-level signal, reducing the likelihood of the model learning to predict PVS scores via PVS-correlated imaging features, instead of actual PVS. Secondly, the PVS mask-processing modules can be trained on additional images that lack ground-truth PVS scores, provided that silver-standard PVS masks can be generated for them. This allows these modules (and, indirectly, the overall scoring pipeline) to benefit from a larger and more anatomically and pathologically diverse training set. We emphasise that the silver-standard segmentation masks are imperfect, but cheap to generate compared to either manual segmentations, and even visual PVS scores if datasets are large. Hence, the effective utilisation of these masks represents a real opportunity for scaling up training datasets. Moreover, our approach automatically benefits from any advances in automated PVS segmentation. This work makes the following contributions:
blocks.zh: 在这部作品中,我们开发了机器学习模型来预测BG和CSO PVS的分数在经过修改(但不是二合位化)的Potters/Wardlaw比例. 与以前的工作不同,我们介绍的方法是为了在训练和(或)推论期间使用PVS分区口罩(除地面真实PVS分数外)。 我们在训练中使用的面具是通过半自动管道产生的,因此被称为“银标准”。 使用这些口罩的能力提供了两个主要的好处. 首先,口罩提供了较低的信号,降低了模型学习通过PVS-cor相关成像特征预测PVS分数的可能性,而不是实际PVS. 第二,PVS的口罩处理模块可以就额外的缺乏地面真实的PVS分数的图像进行训练,前提是可以为它们生成银标准的PVS口罩. 这使这些模块(以及间接的整体评分管道)能够受益于更大和更解剖和病理多样化的成套培训。 我们强调银标准分解口罩不完善,但与手动分解相比,生成成本低廉,如果数据集大,甚至视觉PVS得分. 因此,有效使用这些口罩是扩大培训数据集的真正机会。 此外,我们的办法自动受益于自动光电阻分解的任何进展。 这项工作作出了以下贡献:

blocks.en: 1. We develop models for automated BG and CSO PVS scoring on a modified Potters/Wardlaw scale. 2. We develop and compare three methods for utilising silver-standard PVS segmentation masks in addition to ground truth PVS scores in the development of PVS scoring models. 3. We show that multi-task learning is an effective method of incorporating segmentation supervision into the development of PVS scoring models, yielding a model which is better able to localise individual PVS.
blocks.zh: 一、导 言 我们开发了自动BG和CSO PVS的模型,在经过修改的波特斯/Wardlaw尺度上评分. 2. 我们开发并比较了在开发PVS评分模型时,除了地面真理PVS分数外,还有三种使用银标准PVS分数罩的方法。 3. 我们显示,多任务学习是将分化监督纳入PVS评分模型发展的一种有效方法,可以产生一个能够更好地使个人PVS本地化的模式。

blocks.en: 2 Data
blocks.zh: 2 数据

blocks.en: 2.1 Datasets and ground truth
blocks.zh: 2.1 数据集和地面真相

blocks.en: We used data from five different datasets (described below, with scanner details in Table 1 ), all with T1-weighted (T1w), T2-weighted (T2w), and fluid-attenuated inversion recovery (FLAIR) MRI sequences available. Subjects from 4/5 datasets (i.e., the Mild Stroke Study datasets (MSS1, MSS2, and MSS3) [ 26 , 27 , 5 ] , and the Lothian Birth Cohort 1936 dataset (LBC1936) [ 24 ] ) were given a BG and CSO PVS score following the Potters/Wardlaw scale by one of a number of trained observers. Additionally, PVS segmentation masks are available for some subjects. For the MSS1, MSS2, MSS3, and LBC1936 datasets, these PVS masks were generated using a semi-automatic method which utilises vesselness filters and careful threshold selection [ 23 , 10 ] followed by manual edit by a trained analyst. We refer to these masks as “silver-standard” because they are not fully manually derived, nor have they all been meticulously scrutinised by an expert. The PVS segmentation masks in the Vascular Lesion Detection Challenge dataset (VALDO) [ 20 ] are manually generated, however there are only six. In the remainder of this paper we refer to all the PVS masks as “silver-standard”, since the non-VALDO masks constitute the overwhelming majority.
blocks.zh: 我们使用了五个不同数据集的数据(下文说明,表1中有扫描仪细节),所有数据集都有T1加权(T1w),T2加权(T2w),以及流体增压反转恢复(FLAIR)磁共振序列。 来自4/5数据集(即Mild Stroke研究数据集(MSS1,MSS2,和MSS3)[26,27,5],以及Lothian Birth Cohort 1936数据集(LBC1936)[24])的主题被一些训练有素的观察者之一按照波特斯/沃德瓦夫比例表给予BG和CSO PVS分数. 此外,有些科目有PVS分区口罩。 对于MSS1、MSS2、MSS3和LBC1936数据集,这些PVS口罩是使用半自动方法生成的,该方法使用船体滤波器和仔细的阈值选择[23,10],然后由训练有素的分析员手工编辑。 我们把这些面具称为“银质标准”,因为这些面具不是完全手工产生的,也没有经过专家的仔细审查。 在VALDO检测挑战数据集(VALDO)[20]中的PVS分区口罩是人工生成的,不过只有6个. 在本文件的其余部分,我们把所有PVS口罩称为“银质标准”,因为非VALDO口罩占绝大多数。

blocks.en: 2.2 Preprocessing
blocks.zh: 2.2 预处理

blocks.en: 2.2.1 General

Scans were rigidly registered and resampled to 1 mm isotropic resolution. We used SynthStrip [ 11 ] for brain extraction (using the T2w MRI scan for each subject). Scans were then cropped to the brain bounding box, before zero-padding to ensure the image shape was a multiple of 32. Finally, intensity normalisation was applied within the brain mask, saturating at the 2nd and 98th percentile, and mapping all values into the range [0,1].
blocks.zh: 扫描器被刚性地登记下来,并重印到1毫米异热带分辨率。 我们用合成技术[11]来提取大脑(每个主体使用T2w磁共振扫描). 然后将扫描片切到大脑边框上,然后进行零铺设以确保图像形状是32的倍数。 最后,强度正常化被应用在脑罩内,在二和九十八百分位饱和,并将所有值映射到范围[0].

blocks.en: 2.2.2 Generating region of interest masks
blocks.zh: 2.2.2 产生利益面具的区域

blocks.en: To generate binary masks for the BG and CSO, we combined anatomical segmentations from SynthSeg [ 3 ] with a manually drawn exclusion template (a binary mask covering midline and ventricular-adjacent areas where artefacts frequently mimic PVS). We non-linearly registered this custom template to each subject’s T1w image using NiftyReg [ 15 , 14 ] .
blocks.zh: 为了为BG和CSO生成二进制口罩,我们将合成SynthSeg[3]的解剖分解与人工绘制的排除模板(二进制口罩覆盖中线和通风-邻近地区,其中艺术品经常模仿PVS)结合起来. 我们使用 NiftyReg [15, 14] 非线性地将这个自定义模板注册到每个主题的 T1w 图像 。

blocks.en: For the BG mask, we started by defining BG-relevant anatomies using the SynthSeg output. These regions are the thalamus, caudate, putamen, pallidum, and accumbens area. Because these initial labels can be overly conservative for the BG, we expanded the region using a 6 mm binary dilation. To ensure this expansion did not encompass unwanted structures, we removed any voxels overlapping with the registered exclusion template. Finally, we constrained the BG mask to voxels within either the initial BG-relevant anatomies, or cerebral white matter.
blocks.zh: 对于BG面具,我们首先用SynthSeg输出来定义与BG相关的解剖. 这些地区是丘脑,阴茎,putamen,palilidum,和accumbens地区. 因为这些最初的标签对于BG来说可能过于保守,所以我们使用6毫米二进制的缩写来扩展这个区域. 为了确保这种扩展不包含不必要的结构,我们删除了与注册的排除模板重叠的任何阴道。 最后,我们把BG的面具 限制在初始的BG相关解剖中 或大脑白物质中

blocks.en: For the CSO mask, we initialised a mask using the cerebral white matter labels produced by SynthSeg. We then subtracted any voxels that intersected with either the exclusion template or the finalised BG mask. Figure 2 shows an example of the resulting masks.
blocks.zh: 对于 COS 口罩,我们使用 SynthSeg 制作的大脑白物质标签将口罩关闭 。 然后,我们减去了与排除模板或最终化的BG面具相交的任何阴道。 图2显示了由此产生的面具的例子。

blocks.en: 2.3 Agreement between PVS masks and PVS scores
blocks.zh: 2.3 PVS口罩和PVS分数之间的协议

blocks.en: Given the unambiguous nature of the Potters/Wardlaw scale as it is described in the user guide 1 1 1 https://edwebcontent.ed.ac.uk/sites/default/files/imports/fileManager/epvs-rating-scale-user-guide.pdf , in theory, solving PVS segmentation would also solve PVS scoring. We derived maximum PVS counts from the silver-standard PVS segmentation maps, algorithmically, by looping over every slice and each hemisphere, performing 2D connected components analysis, and counting the number of components within the region of interest (BG or CSO) mask in the slice. The maximum number recorded in each ROI is then, in theory, the number that a radiologist would use to assign a score on the Potters/Wardlaw scale.

blocks.en: Figure 3 shows that, for our data, this algorithmic segmentation-based approach to PVS scoring does not work sufficiently well. Notably, the segmentation-derived maximum PVS count is often much higher, especially for CSO, than would be expected given the visual PVS score. There are two reasons as to why these differences may arise. The first reason is related to the segmentation masks themselves; as noted already, these masks are not expertly manually annotated and so, while they have been confirmed to be of a reasonable quality, they are not perfect. The second reason is related to the scores. While the Potters/Wardlaw scale is perfectly clear, it is unrealistic to expect a busy clinical researcher to painstakingly count the number of PVS in each slice and each hemisphere of an MRI scan. It is much more realistic for them to examine the MRI scan, with the Potters/Wardlaw scale in mind, and give their “impression” of the score based on the perceived severity. This “impression” is extremely valuable, since it may take into account additional factors (e.g., other small vessel disease markers, scan quality, etc.). For this reason, learning a model which can approximate this expert “impression” is the ultimate goal of this research and we consider the PVS score the ultimate ground truth, while the silver-standard segmentation masks should be thought of as additional and correlated data that we can use to ground our PVS scoring models via segmentation-aware processing.
blocks.zh: 图3显示,对于我们的数据来说,这种基于算法的分解方法对PVS评分不起作用。 值得注意的是,分化产生的最大PVS计数往往比视觉PVS得分的预期要高得多,对民间社会组织而言尤其如此。 造成这些差异的原因有两个。 第一个原因与分解口罩本身有关;如前所述,这些口罩并非经过专家手动说明,因此,虽然已经证实其质量合理,但并不完美. 第二个原因与得分有关. 虽然波特斯/沃德劳的尺度是完全清楚的,但期望一位忙碌的临床研究人员在核磁共振扫描的每个切片和每个半球都刻苦计算PVS的数量是不现实的。 对他们来说,更现实的做法是审查核磁共振扫描,同时考虑到波特斯/沃德瓦夫的尺度,并根据所认为的严重程度对得分作出“印象”。 这种“印象”极为宝贵,因为它可能考虑到其他因素(如其他小型船只疾病标记、扫描质量等)。 因此,学习一个能够大致衡量这位专家“印象”的模型是这项研究的最终目标,我们认为PVS得分是最终的地面真理,而银标准分解口罩应被视为额外的相关数据,我们可以用来通过分解意识处理来打碎我们的PVS评分模型。

blocks.en: This method follows an identical setup to the baseline CNN, with the exception of the model’s input. An additional input channel is added, which processes the soft predictions from the segmentation U-Net. Prior to training the conditional CNN, the segmentation U-Net is run on the subset of the training data which contains PVS score ground truth. For the subjects which did not have silver-standard binary PVS masks originally, we now attain soft pseudo-labels. For the subjects which did originally have silver-standard PVS masks, we also produce soft pseudo-labels (i.e., the segmentation U-Net predicts on its own training data).

blocks.en: 3.5 Logistic regression
blocks.zh: 3.5 后勤回归

blocks.en: This modelling approach uses two multinomial logistic regression models; one to predict the BG PVS score and one to predict the CSO PVS score. For each model, we performed feature and kernel selection on the validation set, using the mean average precision (mAP) to evaluate performance. Potential features included age, sex, and features derived from the binarised PVS pseudo-labels generated by the segmentation U-Net. Polynomial kernels of degrees 1-3 were evaluated. The selected model for BG PVS prediction utilised a degree 2 polynomial kernel with three features: (1) age; (2) BG PVS volume in the whole scan; and (3) the maximum count of BG PVS in one hemisphere of any slice. The best model for CSO PVS prediction utilised a degree 3 polynomial with three features: (1) sex; (2) the total count of PVS in the whole scan; and (3) the maximum volume of CSO PVS in one hemisphere of any slice.
blocks.zh: 这种建模方法使用两个多数逻辑回归模型;一个预测BG PVS分数,一个预测CSO PVS分数. 对于每个模型,我们在验证集上进行了特征和内核选择,使用平均精度(mAP)来评价性能. 潜在特征包括年龄,性别,以及从分化U-Net生成的二进制PVS伪标签衍生出来的特征. Polynomial内核1-3度被评价. BG PVS预测的选定模型使用了具有以下三个特征的二级聚诺内核:(1) 年龄;(2) 整个扫描中的BG PVS体积;(3) 任意切片的一个半球中BG PVS的最大计数. CSO PVS预测的最佳模型使用了具有以下三个特征的三度聚体:(1) 性别;(2) PVS在整个扫描中的总计数;以及(3) CSO PVS在任何切片的一个半球的最大量.

blocks.en: 3.6 Random seeds and model checkpoints
blocks.zh: 3.6 随机种子和示范检查站

blocks.en: We trained the baseline, conditional, and multi-task CNNs three times, using three different random seeds for initialisation, and performed inference by way of ensembling the probabilistic predictions from each model. The segmentation U-Net used a single random seed. Logistic regression model fitting is a convex optimisation problem, hence, no ensemble was used for this method.
blocks.zh: 我们训练了三次基线、有条件和多任务CNN, 使用三种不同的随机种子进行初始化, 并且通过对每个模型的概率预测进行共解推论。 分区U-Net使用单一随机种子. 逻辑回归模型的配置是一个对流优化问题,因此这种方法没有使用综艺。

blocks.en: For the segmentation U-Net, we selected the model checkpoint achieving the highest Dice similarity coefficient (DSC) [ 6 ] on the validation set, and for the baseline, conditional, and multi-task CNNs we selected the model checkpoints achieving the highest mAP on the validation set.

blocks.zh: 4. 结果和讨论

blocks.en: 4.1 Segmentation model validation
blocks.zh: 4.1 分区模型验证

blocks.en: We trained our segmentation U-Net to approximate the silver-standard PVS segmentation masks. Since these masks were produced by a slower approach, requiring manual tuning, this was necessary to enable our PVS scoring pipelines to be deployed efficiently on new scans. In this section, we evaluate the agreement between the silver-standard PVS masks, and our trained segmentation U-Net model’s predictions. The segmentation U-Net achieved a DSC of 65.06%, 63.45%, and 62.84% on the training, validation, and test sets, respectively, when compared to the silver-standard PVS masks. An example of the PVS segmentations can be seen in Figure 6 .
blocks.zh: 我们训练了我们的分割U-Net 来接近银标准的PVS分割口罩. 由于这些口罩是用较慢的方法制作的,需要人工调试,因此有必要使我们的PVS评分管道能够有效地部署在新的扫描上. 在这个部分,我们评价银标准PVS口罩与我们训练有素的分区U-Net模型的预测之间的一致。 与银标准PVS口罩相比,分离U-Net在培训、验证和测试装置上分别实现了65.06%、63.45%和62.84%的DSC。 图6显示了PVS分裂的例子。

blocks.en: While the actual agreement of the two segmentation masks is interesting, we are most concerned with assessing whether or not the segmentation U-Net’s masks possess similar utility to the silver-standard masks, when used in downstream PVS score prediction pipelines. This is indeed confirmed to be the case for the conditional CNN and logistic regression methods. These experiments are presented in B .
blocks.zh: 虽然两种分片口罩的实际一致是有趣的,但我们最关心的是评估分片U-Net的口罩在下游PVS分数预测管道中使用时是否具有与银标准口罩相似的效用. 有条件的CNN和后勤回归方法确实如此。 B节介绍了这些实验。

blocks.en: It is also interesting to evaluate the performance of the multi-task CNN on PVS segmentation. We evaluated the DSC compared with the silver-standard masks for each of the three models (from the three random seeds) and averaged the result. The model achieved 55.81%, 56.88%, and 54.27% on the training, validation, and test sets, respectively. This is considerably lower than the segmentation U-Net, as expected, and we attribute the result to three primary factors: (1) the architecture is not optimised for segmentation (the mask decoder has less parameters than the U-Net’s decoder, deep supervision is not used, and group normalisation is used instead of instance normalisation); (2) while we show that the segmentation task is beneficial to the model’s ability to detect and score PVS (as indicated by the results below), this is likely not a mutually beneficial relationship; and (3) we selected the checkpoints based on mAP on the PVS scoring task, not DSC on the PVS segmentation task.
blocks.zh: 还值得评价关于PVS分区的多任务CNN的性能. 我们评价了DSC与三个型号中每个型号(从三个随机种子)的银标准口罩对比,并平均得出了结果. 该模式分别实现了55.81%、56.88%和54.27%的培训、鉴定和测试。 这比预期的分割U-Net要低得多,我们将此结果归结为三个主要因素:(1) 架构不优化为分割(面具解码器的参数比U-Net的解码器少,没有使用深度监管,而是使用分组正常化,而不是实例正常化);(2) 虽然我们表明分割任务有利于模型检测和分级PVS的能力(如下文所示),但这很可能不是一个互利的关系;(3) 我们根据PVS分级任务选择了基于mAP的检查站,而不是基于PVS分级任务的DSC.

blocks.en: 4.2 Comparison of PVS scoring models
blocks.zh: 4.2 PVS评分模型比较

blocks.en: The results presented in Table 3 show that the two deep learning-based approaches which utilise the silver-standard PVS masks—either directly (the multi-task CNN), or via the segmentation U-Net’s pseudo-label predictions (the conditional U-Net)—strongly out perform both the baseline CNN, which does not utilise any segmentations, and the logistic regression models, which utilises only basic features derived from the segmentation U-Net’s pseudo-labels, in addition to age (BG model) and sex (CSO model). The multi-task learning approach exhibits the best or joint best performance across all metrics, and is the only method to exhibit a statistically significant ( p = 0.03 p=0.03 ) improvement over the logistic regression models on mean F1 score, according to paired difference bootstrap testing (pairwise statistics in D ). Confusion matrices are shown in Figure 8 .
blocks.zh: 表3的结果表明,使用银标准PVS口罩的两个深层学习方法——要么是直接使用(多任务CNN),要么是通过分区U-Net的伪标签预测(有条件的U-Net)——有力地完成了基线CNN(不使用任何分区),要么是后勤回归模型(除了年龄(BG模型)和性别(CSO模型)之外,仅使用分区U-Net伪标签的基本特征)。 多任务学习方法在所有衡量标准中都表现出最佳或共同的最佳业绩,根据配对的差幅靴子测试(D的误差统计),这是在平均F1分上的后勤回归模型上显示具有统计意义(p = 0.03 p = 0.03)改进的唯一方法。 迷惑矩阵见图8。

blocks.en: 4.3 Multi-task model validation
blocks.zh: 4.3 多任务模式验证

blocks.en: In this section, we performed additional experiments to validate our best-performing model: the multi-task CNN. Given the difficulty of accurately predicting the PVS score with even our best model, we consider four avenues for evaluating its real-world utility. The first is through the use of 3D gradient-weighted class activation mapping (GradCAM) [ 19 ] , to confirm that the model actually uses the PVS visible in the image to guide its prediction. The second is via visualisation of the distribution of probabilistic outputs of the model. The third is an evaluation of clinical validity: assessing whether the model’s predicted PVS scores share the same associations with established clinical biomarkers as the trained observer’s ground truth scores. The fourth is an evaluation of inter-rater reliability comparing our model and two trained observers.
blocks.zh: 在这一节中,我们进行了更多的实验来验证我们最出色的模型:多任务CNN. 鉴于很难用我们的最佳模式准确预测PVS的得分,我们考虑了评估其现实世界效用的四种途径。 第一个是通过使用3D梯度加权类激活映射(GradCAM)[19],确认模型实际使用图像中可见的PVS来指导其预测. 二是通过可视化模式概率输出的分布. 第三是临床有效性评价:评估模型预测的PVS分数是否与训练有素的观察者地面真实分数相同,与既定的临床生物标志有相同的关联. 第四是比较我们的模型和两名训练有素的观察者,评估了研究者之间的可靠性。

blocks.en: Figure 9 shows the GradCAM for the first layer of the multi-task CNN on an image with a high PVS burden. While care should be taken not to over-interpret visualisations of this kind, we can, very encouragingly, see that several of the most salient features are PVS. This provides us with evidence that our model is indeed performing classification of the PVS score based (at least partially) on the actual PVS, and not based solely on other correlated feature of the image. An extended GradCAM-based analysis can be found in C , where we show that the baseline and conditional CNNs’ maps to not appear to localise PVS in the first layer at all.

blocks.en: Figure 10 shows the distribution of predicted probabilities for each ground truth class (top) and predicted class (bottom), and can be used to inspect the confidence of true positive (both, correct colour), false positive (bottom, wrong colour), and false negative (top, wrong colour) predictions. We can see from the bottom row, for both BG and CSO PVS, the model is less confident in predicting scores of 2, than 1 or 3. This is a reassuring finding. In our modified scale, a score of 2 represents a specific intermediate count (11-20 individual PVS). In contrast, scores of 1 include subjects with ≤ \leq 10 PVS (including perfectly healthy subjects) and scores of 3 represent an open-ended interval with ≥ \geq 21 PVS. Because a score of 2 is bounded on both sides, the margin for error is smaller, and the sensitivity required to distinguish these cases is higher. Low confidence on this difficult intermediate class—even when the prediction is correct—suggests that the model is evaluating true PVS-relevant features rather than relying on spurious correlations.
blocks.zh: 图10显示每个地面真伪类(上层)和预测类(下层)的预测概率分布,可用于检查真实正性(既正确颜色,也正确颜色),假正性(下层,错误颜色)和假负性(上层,错误颜色)预测的置信度. 我们从下行可以看到,对于BG和CSO PVS来说,模型对预测2比1或3的分数没有那么自信. 这是一个令人放心的结论。 在我们修改的比额表中,2分代表一个特定的中间计数(11-20个人PVS). 相比之下,1的分数包括使用 \leq 10 PVS 的科目(包括完全健康的科目),3的分数代表一个与\geq 21 PVS 的无限制间隔. 由于2的分数是两边的,因此误差的比值较小,区分这些情况所需的灵敏度较高. 对这种困难的中间类(即使在预测正确的情况下)缺乏信心,建议该模型评价的是真正的PVS相关特征,而不是依赖虚假的关联。

blocks.en: From the bottom row we can see that in general there is a correspondence between high confidence predictions and accuracy. With the exception of CSO PVS scores of 2, there are noticeably more correct predictions than incorrect predictions above the 75th percentile of predicted probabilities. Additionally, high confidence false positives for scores 1 and 3 are both more frequently false negatives for score 2, than for scores 3 or 1, providing further evidence to suggest that the model has discovered the ordinal nature of the data.
blocks.zh: 从下行可以看出,总的来说,高度信心预测和准确性之间有对应关系。 除了CSO PVS的分数2以外,显然还有比预测概率第75个百分点以上的不正确的预测更正确的预测. 此外,对1分和3分的高度信心假阳性对于2分比对3或1分更常见的为2分和3分的假阴性,提供了进一步的证据,表明模型发现了数据的正统性.

blocks.en: Next, we utilised a subset of the test set (200/248) with a number of clinical variables available: age, sex, hypertension, white matter hyperintensity (WMH) volume, and presence of any ischaemic stroke lesions (ISL). We fit two ordinal logistic regression models on this data; one model used the trained observer’s ground truth PVS scores as the dependent variable, while the other model used the predicted PVS scores from the multi-task CNN as the dependent variable.
blocks.zh: 接下来,我们利用了一组测试(200/248)的子集,其中有一些临床变量:年龄、性别、高血压、白物质超强度(WMH)体积以及有无缺血性中风损伤(ISL)。 我们在此数据上搭配了两个正统物流回归模型;一个模型使用训练有素的观察者地面真理PVS分数作为依赖变量,而另一个模型则使用多任务CNN预测的PVS分数作为依赖变量.

blocks.en: Examining the results displayed in Table 4 , we can see that to optimally model both the ground truth scores and the predicted scores using these clinical variables, similar normalised beta coefficients are needed. All betas are in agreement regarding the direction of the correlation and the most statistically significant predictor is white matter hyperintensity volume for all models. From a clinical perspective, these results are encouraging. They demonstrate that the multi-task CNN predictions preserve the expected relationships with established cerebrovascular risk factors.
blocks.zh: 从表4显示的结果来看,我们可以看到,为了最好地模拟地面真实分数和使用这些临床变量预测的分数,需要类似的正常β系数。 所有β都同意相关性的方向,在统计上最重要的预测器是所有模型的白物质超强度体积。 从临床角度来看,这些结果令人鼓舞。 它们表明,CNN的多任务预测保留了与既定脑血管风险因素的预期关系.

blocks.en: Finally, for a small subset of the test set (62/248), two trained observers independently provided PVS scores. Figure 11 shows the linear-weighted Cohen’s Kappa between the two trained observers and the multi-task CNN model. On BG PVS score, the two trained observers have the highest agreement, and the CNN model has higher agreement with observer 2 than observer 1. On CSO PVS score, the trained observers again have the highest agreement, but it is considerably lower than their agreement on BG PVS scores (a result also observed in [ 17 ] ) and also lower than the observer-model agreement on BG PVS scores. The model has higher agreement with observer 1 than observer 2 for CSO PVS scores. While the level of agreement between observers and between the model and observers are quite similar, these results—although limited in their power by the size of the dataset—indicate that even for this difficult and (in practice) subjective task, human observers are likely still more reliable than our automated multi-task CNN, when reliability is measured between raters. An analysis of intra-rater variability would, of course, highlight the algorithmic consistency inherent to automated computational methods, which is a highly desirable trait.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: In this work, we developed and evaluated three distinct modelling methodologies for utilising silver-standard PVS segmentation masks to predict PVS scores on a modified Potters/Wardlaw scale. We demonstrated that integrating this segmentation data enables the training of a more accurate CNN-based model, with multi-task learning emerging as the most successful paradigm. Our GramCAM-based analysis revealed that multi-task learning resulted in a model which learned to localise individual PVS—a quality not shown by the baseline or conditional CNNs.
blocks.zh: 在这项工作中,我们开发并评价了三种不同的建模方法,用于利用银标准PVS分片罩来预测PVS在经过修改的波特斯/沃德瓦夫尺度上的得分. 我们证明,将这种分解数据结合起来,可以培训一个更准确的基于CNN的模型,以多任务学习为最成功的范例。 我们基于格拉姆CAM的分析显示,多任务学习产生了一种模式,可以使个人PVS本地化——基线或有条件的CNN没有显示这种质量。

blocks.en: The evaluation of this multi-task model highlighted its clinical utility. Although its inter-rater agreement with independent trained observers was lower than the agreement between the observers themselves, the inter-rater agreement of the observers was only 0.66 and 0.36 for the BG and CSO PVS scores respectively, highlighting the difficulty of the task and the need for standardisation via automation. The model behaved in a probabilistically sensible manner, exhibiting appropriately lower confidence on more difficult classes. Furthermore, the model’s predictions maintained similar associations with established clinical markers of neurovascular health as the trained observer’s ground truth, demonstrating strong clinical validity.
blocks.zh: 这一多任务模式的评价突出了其临床用途。 虽然其与接受过独立训练的观察员的师际协议低于观察员之间的协议,但观察员的师际协议对BG和CSOPVS的分数分别只有0.66和0.36,凸显了任务的难度和通过自动化实现标准化的必要性. 模型的行为方式很合理,对比较困难的班级表现出了相当低的信心。 此外,模型的预测还维持了类似的联系,将神经血管健康的临床标记作为训练有素的观察者的地面真理,表明临床上的有效性很强。

blocks.en: Currently, our model utilises a modified version of the Potters/Wardlaw scale due to the limited number of subjects presenting with scores of 0 or 4 in our datasets. To maximise the clinical applicability of this approach, future work should focus on reproducing this model using the full Potters/Wardlaw scale once sufficient training data is aggregated. Ideally, this expansion should also incorporate the binary midbrain PVS score.
blocks.zh: 目前,我们的模型采用了波特斯/沃德劳星表的修改版,因为数据集中显示的分数为0或4的科目数量有限。 为了最大限度地扩大这一方法在临床上的可适用性,今后的工作应侧重于一旦充分汇总培训数据,就使用完整的波特斯/沃德劳模型复制这一模型。 理想的情况是,这种扩展还应包括二进制中脑PVS分数.

blocks.en: Ultimately, automating PVS scoring addresses an immediate need in neurovascular research. While accurate automated segmentation represents the long-term ideal for deriving repeatable, quantitative measures, visual scoring remains the current clinical standard because it is fast, practical, and widely applicable. By learning to replicate the implicit policy of a trained observer, our automated scoring model bridges this gap, providing a tool for identifying health associations and improving disease risk modelling today, while the field continues to advance toward robust segmentation in the future.
blocks.zh: 最终,PVS评分自动化解决了神经血管研究中的即时需求. 虽然准确的自动化分解代表了得出可重复的定量计量的长期理想,但视觉评分仍然是目前的临床标准,因为它是快速的,实用的,并且广泛适用的. 通过学习复制训练有素的观察者的隐含政策,我们的自动评分模型弥合了这一差距,为识别健康协会和改进今天的疾病风险模型提供了工具,同时这个领域在未来继续朝着强大的分化方向前进。

blocks.en: Although we attempted to account for the variability in results on the test data via bootstrapping, and the variability in the training process via ensembling the results of multiple independent training runs, the use of a single data split is a limitation of this study.
blocks.zh: 虽然我们试图通过拖鞋计算测试数据结果的变异性,以及培训过程中通过多重独立培训结果的变异性,但使用单一数据分割是本研究的一个局限性。

blocks.en: Appendix A Model configuration details

blocks.en: A.1 Common data augmentation and preprocessing
blocks.zh: A.1 共同数据扩充和预处理

blocks.en: For all deep learning models, data augmentation was implemented with TorchIO [ 16 ] and consisted of the following random operations: isotropic affine transformation ( p = 1.0 p=1.0 , scale=[0.9, 1.1], rotation=[-90, +90]); Gaussian noise ( p = 0.15 p=0.15 , mean=0, std=[0, 0.316]); Gaussian blur ( p = 0.1 p=0.1 , std=[0.5, 1.5]); brightness adjustment ( p = 0.15 p=0.15 , multiplier=[0.7, 1.3]); contrast adjustment ( p = 0.15 p=0.15 , gamma=[0.65, 1.5]); flip along any axis ( p = 0.5 p=0.5 ); and low resolution simulation in any axis via nearest neighbour downsampling and linear upsampling ( p = 0.25 p=0.25 , factor=[1, 2]).
blocks.zh: 对所有深层学习模型,采用了火炬IO[16],由下列随机操作组成:异构异构异构异构变换(p=1.0p=1.0p=1.0,尺度=[0.9,1.1],旋转=[-90,+90]);高斯噪音(p=0.15p=0.15,平均值=0,std=[0],0.316]);高斯模糊(p=0.1p=0.1,std=[0.5,1.5]);亮度调整(p=0.15,乘积=[0.7,1.3]);对比调整(p=0.15p=0.15,γ=[0.65,1.5]);沿任何轴向上翻转(p=0.5p=0.5);通过最近的邻下取样和线性取样,在任何轴上进行低分辨率模拟(p=0.25p=0.25p=0.25,因数[1,2])。

blocks.en: All models were trained using full 3D image patches. Before being passed into the network, the augmented patches are renormalised so voxel intensities are in the range [0, 1] using the brain mask, saturating at the 2nd and 98th percentiles.
blocks.zh: 所有模型都使用完整的3D图像补丁来训练. 在被传入网络之前,增强的补丁被重新正常化,所以阴道强度在[0,1]范围内,使用脑罩,在二和九十八百分位饱和.

blocks.en: A.2 Segmentation U-Net
blocks.zh: A.2 分区U-Net

blocks.en: We trained the U-Net segmentation model using best practices developed in nnU-Net [ 12 ] . The DynUNet model from MONAI [ 4 ] was used to instantiate the architecture, with 6 levels of spatial resolution with 32, 64, 128, 256, 320, and 320 channels respectively, 3 × 3 × 3 3\times 3\times 3 kernels, residual blocks, instance normalisation, Leaky ReLU activations with a slope coefficient of 0.01, and three levels of additional deep supervision, with normalised exponentially decreasing loss weights (as per nnU-Net).
blocks.zh: 我们利用在nnU-Net[12]中形成的最佳做法培训了U-Net分块模式。 来自 MONAI [4] 的 DynUNet 模型用于即时化架构,其空间分辨率为6级,分别为32,64,128,256,320和320通道,3 × 3 × 3 → 3 时 3 内核,残块,例态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态

blocks.en: The segmentation loss function was the equally weighted sum of Dice and Cross-Entropy loss, using stochastic gradient descent and polynomial learning rate decay starting at 0.01 with a power of 0.9, as per nnU-Net. We employed an effective batch size of 6, achieved via gradient accumulation. The model was trained for 1000 epochs.
blocks.zh: 分化损失函数是Dice和Cross-Entropy损失的等量加权总和,按照nU-Net,使用自0.01开始的分化梯度下降和多诺学习率衰减,功率0.9。 我们采用了6号有效批量,通过梯度积累实现。 该模型接受了1000个纪元的培训.

blocks.en: A.3 Baseline and conditional CNNs
blocks.zh: A.3 基线和有条件的CNN

blocks.en: We used a 3D ResNet model from MONAI with 1, 2, 2, and 4 blocks per layer and with 32, 64, 128, and 256 channels, respectively. To preserve small features like PVS, we omitted the initial max pooling layer. We also applied a 1 × 1 × 1 1\times 1\times 1 convolution and a 3 × 3 × 3 3\times 3\times 3 convolution in parallel to the standard initial 7 × 7 × 7 7\times 7\times 7 convolution, summing the results prior to the first normalisation and activation.
blocks.zh: 我们使用了来自MONAI的3D ResNet模型,每层有1,2,2和4块,并分别有32,64,128和256个频道. 为了保存像PVS这样的小特征,我们省略了初始最大集合层. 我们还应用了1×1×1\1\1\1\1volution1volution1volution3\3\3\3\3volution3volution3volution3volution3volution3volution3volution3volution3volution3volution3volution3volution7\7\

blocks.en: We replaced the single prediction head with two heads, one for the BG and one for the CSO. The Cross-Entropy loss was used as the classification loss function, with class weights selected to balance the dataset and a label smoothing factor of 0.1. We used group normalisation with 8 groups, ReLU activation, and the AdamW optimiser (learning rate = 0.001, betas = (0.9, 0.999)). We employed an effective batch size of 220, achieved via gradient accumulation. In addition to the three MRI sequences, BG and CSO masks were also input to the network. The conditional CNN additionally included the PVS pseudo-labels produced by the segmentation U-Net as an input channel. The models were trained for 1000 epochs.
blocks.zh: 我们用两个头取代了单一的预测头,一个是BG头,一个是CSO头. Cross-Entropy损失被用作分类损失函数,选择类权重来平衡数据集,标签平滑系数为0.1. 我们使用了8个组的组态化,ReLU激活,以及AdamW Opimiser(学习率=0.001,βs=(0.9,0.999)). 我们采用了220个有效批量规模,通过梯度积累实现。 除了三个核磁共振序列外,BG和CSO的口罩也为网络提供了投入。 有条件的CNN还把分区U-Net生产的PVS伪标签作为输入通道. 这些模型接受了1000个世纪的培训。

blocks.en: A.4 Multitask CNN
blocks.zh: A.4 多任务CNN

blocks.en: We used the same 3D ResNet architecture as above, but added a lightweight segmentation decoder. The decoder is symmetric with the encoder, but with only a single ResNet block per layer. The lower-resolution feature maps of the previous layer are upsampled with transposed convolutions and concatenated with skip connections from the equivalent encoder layer output (as in a standard U-Net) before each layer.
blocks.zh: 我们使用了与上述相同的3D ResNet架构,但增加了一个轻量级分区解码器. 解码器与编码器对称,但每层只有一个ResNet块. 上层的下分辨率特征图用转录转录图样进行检测,并在每层前用等效编码器层输出的跳转连接(如标准U-Net)进行拼接.

blocks.en: For the loss function, we set the base task weighting α = 0.5 \alpha=0.5 (refer to the main paper), which is dynamically scaled by the parameter β \beta to appropriately balance the segmentation and classification components (refer to the main paper). All other training details are identical to the baseline CNN.
blocks.zh: 对于损失函数,我们设定了基本任务权重α=0.5\alpha=0.5(参见主纸),该值由参数β\β进行动态缩放,以适当平衡分区和分类成分(参见主纸). 所有其他训练细节与基线CNN相同.

blocks.en: A.5 Logistic regression
blocks.zh: A.5 后勤回归

blocks.en: The details of our multinomial logistic regression model selection approach are covered in the main body of this paper. The feature pool included age, sex, and the following PVS statistics derived from the segmentation U-Net’s pseudo-labels: total volume and count (calculated both globally and masked to the BG and CSO), and the maximum single-slice volume and count per hemisphere (calculated only within the BG and CSO).
blocks.zh: 本文正文详细介绍了我们的多名后勤回归模式选择办法。 功能池包括年龄,性别,以及从分区U-Net的伪标签中得出的以下PVS统计:总量和计数(计算全球范围,并掩盖到BG和CSO),以及每个半球最大单切片量和计数(仅在BG和CSO内部计算).

blocks.en: All features (except sex) were z-score standardised. The standardisation statistics (mean and standard deviation) were calculated exclusively on the training set and then applied to the validation and test sets. The LBFGS optimiser with a maximum of 5000 iterations and an L2 penalty was used.
blocks.zh: 所有特征(除性别外)都是z分标准化的. 标准化统计(平均偏差和标准偏差)完全根据培训集计算,然后应用于验证和测试集。 使用LBFGS选用器,最多可重复5000次,L2级。

blocks.zh: B.1 后勤回归

blocks.en: For the BG model using the original silver-standard PVS masks a degree 2 polynomial with four features ((1) age; (2) PVS volume in the whole scan; (3) PVS volume in the BG; and (4) the maximum count of BG PVS in one hemisphere of any slice) was selected, and for the BG model using the pseudo-labels a degree 2 polynomial with two features ((1) PVS volume in the BG; and (2) the maximum count of BG PVS in one hemisphere of any slice) selected.
blocks.zh: BG模型使用最初的银标准PVS遮盖了具有四个特性的二度多元性((1)年龄;(2)全扫描的PVS体积;(3)BG的PVS体积;和(4)任意切片的一个半球的BGPV的最大计数),BG模型使用具有两个特性的二度多元性((1)BG的PVS体积;(2)任意切片的一个半球的BGPVS的最大计数).

blocks.en: For the CSO model using the original silver-standard PVS masks a degree 1 polynomial with five features ((1) sex; (2) age; (3) PVS volume in the whole scan; (4) PVS volume in the CSO; and (5) PVS count in the CSO) was selected, and for the CSO model using the pseudo-labels a degree 3 polynomial with five features ((1) sex; (2) age; (3) PVS volume in the whole scan; (4) PVS volume in the CSO; and (5) the maximum count of CSO PVS in one hemisphere of any slice) selected.
